claims: s(12) >= 7943/2000 = 3.9715, by s12_lower_3.9715.txt: Evan Daniel's 1,736 points of s12/certificates/s12_lower_3.9686.txt (evand/square-packing 7d6f46d9) dilated by 31382793/31360000 and rounded to the grid 1/4000000 one D4 orbit at a time, with new weights found by linear programming, all 223 orbits positive, total 119974808/10^7 < 12 (README.md, paper/s12_lower_3.9715.pdf)

Daniel's verify at 7d6f46d, built with overflow checks, verifies it on the angle net N = 96000 with least captured weight 10000050/10^7 at bin 0 and refuses it at N = 24000 (6737611/10^7); tools/indep_check.cpp, unchanged since v1.0, verifies it at N = 96000 and 192000 and refuses it at 24000 and 48000 (logs/3.9715/)
Two altered copies, the heaviest orbit lowered by 100/10^7 and the same integers read over D = 3999600, are refused by indep_check at N = 96000 and by single-bin runs of verify (controls/3.9715/)
The LP for D4-invariant weights on these points exceeds 12 at s = 3.97155 on N = 96000, and finer nets move the obstruction toward 560/141 (README.md, How far these points go; search/)

v1.0's text called its certificate essentially critical; for the rejecting bin of the 31360/7900 control at N = 96000, actual unit squares at both end angles capture at least 10048468/10^7 on a 401 x 401 grid of centres (tools/exact_pose.py, logs/exact_pose_*.log)
